source_caption_text:
San Bernardino Artist KingMostWanted Has Reportedly Passed Away 🕊️💔

KINGMOSTWANTED was a California rapper from the Inland Empire, particularly associated with San Bernardino. He began releasing music around 2018 and quickly developed a following for his laid-back delivery, catchy West Coast sound, and energetic personality. 

He broke through with songs like “In My City” and “8K Anthem,” while “Different Varieties” became a major viral moment, especially on TikTok. His music has also connected him with artists such as MCM Raymond, Mike Sherm, AZChike, and Peysoh. 

One of his biggest career moments came when “How 2 Ride” was included on the Road to Fast 9 mixtape alongside major names in hip-hop. He has continued releasing music, including projects such as Time For the Throne, Notorious King, NO HEIR NEEDED, and I AM, which was released in 2026.
